known_issues: The two outer stages reuse the full pinned native ancestry and the unchanged structured-source job. Two stages do not mean two native processes; no aggregate native CPU, RSS, scratch, descriptor or descendant budget is qualified.
The 300-second post-admission limit checks elapsed acceptance after synchronous stages and before return. It does not preempt a running child or establish a hard aggregate job deadline.
Identical PDF, IR, text-plan, page, language, profile and job bindings are unsigned metadata agreement, not authenticated worker execution or clinical release authority.

The native receipt establishes same-font explicit width coverage only. It does not audit Unicode meanings, visible glyphs, font programs, metric correctness, reading order or full PDF/UA accessibility.
Existing source and forward/reverse linkage checks retain their narrow qualifications. No scientific equivalence, finding completeness or semantic accessibility qualification is added.
The width receipt does not expose ancestor role inventories; this composition does not invent cross-validator agreement for unexposed counts.
Bounded native-JSON capture and subsequent source comparisons detect persistent mutation. Concurrent mutate-and-restore behavior remains unsupported.
No retry, caller-supplied receipt, custom executor, durable checkpoint or resume input is accepted.

The optional profile admits at most 64 pages and 8 MiB, conditional on all unchanged native/parser/graph/depth limits. The admitted 64-page synthetic renderer fixture omits its excessive automatic bookmark chain during fixture generation only.
The existing default 32-page/8-MiB rendering and delivery route and fixed-worker wire remain unchanged. This optional job does not activate long-report delivery or authorize release.
